title_zh: 确认社区通讯份数并约好分发

scenario.label_zh: 确认通讯发行范围后约定分发
scenario.goal_zh: 确认社区通讯每期的纸质发行量和分发地点，并约定当天分发本期副本

context_zh: 社区通讯编辑与新志愿者安排纸质通讯的分发。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Mabel
sentences.text: How many copies should I collect for today's newsletter delivery?

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: Our print circulation is two hundred per issue. This stack is the whole run.

sentences.speaker: Mabel
sentences.text: Do I take them all to the library?

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: Half go there, and half go to the community centre. Could you circulate them this afternoon?

sentences.speaker: Mabel
sentences.text: Yes. I'll take a hundred to each place and leave them at the agreed collection points.

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: Thank you. Both desks are expecting the bundles today.
